scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, yes – I applied for a VA home loan and I was hoping you could give me an update on where things stand. Can you tell me what the status of my application is?
dialogue.agent: Of course. Your loan application has been processed, and the loan was purchased. It was sold to Ginnie Mae after closing. So your loan is active and has been transferred to them for servicing.

dialogue.user: Oh, okay – so does that mean my loan was approved? I wasn’t entirely sure from that. And what about the details—like the interest rate and total costs of the loan? Can you tell me what my rate is and what the fees or costs are looking like overall?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan was approved and closed successfully. The interest rate on your loan is 6.750%, and the total loan costs came to $3,164.50.

dialogue.user: Alright, thanks for confirming that. That rate is a bit higher than I was expecting, but I’m glad it went through. I have a couple of other questions: were there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? And could you tell me if my debt-to-income ratio had any impact on my application?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features. As for your debt-to-income ratio, that field is not available in your record, so I'm unable to confirm whether it had any impact on your application.

dialogue.user:
I appreciate you answering all that—good to know there aren’t any high-cost or negative amortization issues. Too bad about the DTI info not being available, but I understand. 

Thanks for your help. I’d say I’m <Satisfied> with how this went.
